_comment: Copy to framecue.local.json and fill in. That file is git-ignored and must never be committed.
_livekitUrl: LiveKit Cloud project URL, e.g. wss://your-project.livekit.cloud
_livekitRoom: Room both devices join during development. Must match the tokens below.
_tokens: One per role: two devices need two identities or the second connection evicts the first. lk token create --api-key <key> --api-secret <secret> --join --room framecue-dev --identity coach --valid-for 24h
